description.zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
></notice>
description.en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).
></notice>

description.zh: 声码的唯一标识列表，最多100个元素。
description.en: A list of unique identifiers of sound codes. The list can contain up to 100 elements.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-sound-code-audio --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --sound-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
